messages:
maria: quick sync — finalizing what lands in sprint 0 for the visibility console. scope: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost-by-route, error analytics. need decisions + launch criteria.
ben: +1. main question: do we cut sampling-based tracing for MVP? customers ask for full traces but that spikes cost.
lina: design note — we can ship compact trace links + span counts. full flamegraphs later. propose click-to-fetch full trace.
jake: ops perspective — sampling is critical for latency/cost. propose default 1% sampling, with per-customer override via flag.
chandra: product take — prioritize dashboards (cost & errors) + trace quick-links for MVP. launch criteria need to be concrete (ingestion, backfill, accuracy).
olivia: CS feedback — top asks from pilots: per-route cost, error % by model version, trace hooks for timeout investigations.
maria: OK, draft proposal for MVP: dashboards (cost + errors), trace quick-links (sampled), per-route cost breakdown (approx), error analytics basic (grouping by fingerprint). Launch criteria draft pasted below.
```
- Dashboards: ingestion latency <=5m for streaming metrics; backfill <=24h; show top-10 routes by traffic.
- Tracing: quick-link + span metadata in UI; default sampling 1%; on-demand full-fetch API for individual traces.
- Cost: per-route estimate within 15% error (95th percentile). clearly labeled as "estimate" if heuristics used.
- Errors: automatic grouping by stack/signature, time-series, top-5 fingerprints, root-cause tags when available.
- UX: docs, quickstart, and one demo customer validated before launch.
- SLOs: dashboard queries should render <2s P95 under expected load (x rps).
```
ben: question — per-route cost requires route tagging at request time. do we have route_id headers in requests today? impact on SDKs?
jake: runtime can add a lightweight route_id header. perf overhead should be minimal. cost calculations can be done async.
maria: tradeoff: if adding route tags across SDKs is heavy, we ship heuristic per-route estimates initially and require explicit route tag for exact accounting in phase 2.
chandra: decision proposal: ship heuristic per-route estimates day 0; require explicit route tag for exact cost accounting post-launch. thumbs?
lina: design will surface confidence interval / estimation badge. I'll mock this week.
olivia: CS ok with that if we provide migration docs and an opt-in plan for customers to enable precise accounting.
ben: for tracing hooks — can we default to "trace on error"? that'll save money and catch most customer issues.
jake: implementable — rule: trace-on-error = true for 5xx/timeouts; baseline sampling 1% otherwise. plus on-demand trace capture API.
maria: agreed. who owns rollout + canary?
ben: I'll own canary + perf metrics for rollout.
lina: I'll own UX + mockups; need engineering acceptance criteria by Friday.
chandra: product will own launch checklist and gating doc.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: visibility-service:v0.1 -> canary at 2109876600 (owner: ben)
maria: blockers?
ben: need a feature flag for sampling config + the route_id header. ETA Thu.
jake: infra ask — keep traces retention for 7 days (2x default). estimated infra cost +12%. need finance sign-off.
maria: noted. i'll pull finance in for budget sign-off. olivia — can you prep customer comms and validation plan?
olivia: yes — I'll validate with two pilot customers and draft comms. ETA next Wed.
lina: small UI note — show an "estimate" badge whenever heuristics are used, and tooltip explaining confidence band.
chandra: agreed. summarizing action items:
- ben: implement sampling flag + canary rollout (ETA Thu).
- jake: infra retention + cost estimate (ETA Wed).
- lina: mockups + confidence UI (ETA Fri).
- chandra: launch checklist + gating doc (ETA Mon).
- olivia: customer comms + validation with 2 customers (ETA next Wed).
- maria: budget + exec sign-off (ETA Fri).
ben: noted. tagging follow-ups into #product and #eng-runtime.
maria: wrap-up — thanks all. we'll reconvene if any blocker pops up. :tada:
